name: OMathLimUpp
description: Represents the upper limit mathematical construct, consisting of text on the baseline and reduced-size text immediately above it.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathLimUpp object.

properties.name: E
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the base of the specified equation object. Read-only.

properties.name: Lim
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the limit of the upper limit object. Read-only.

methods.name: ToLimLow
methods.description: Converts an equation from the upper limit to the lower limit.
